description: This file contains utility functions related to durations and time unit conversions, specifically for bubble calculations within the moment.js library, including handling of milliseconds, seconds, minutes, hours, days, months, and years.

methods.name: bubble()
methods.description: Adjusts and normalizes the duration components (milliseconds, seconds, minutes, hours, days, months, years) in the context of moment.js's internal duration representation.

methods.name: daysToMonths(days)
methods.description: Converts a number of days into an equivalent number of months based on average days per month over a 400-year cycle.

methods.name: monthsToDays(months)
methods.description: Converts a number of months into an approximate number of days based on a 400-year cycle.
